adversarial_review.check: P_E rho_U P_E is an unnormalized finite spectral contribution; it is not called a global state or an infinite-volume KMS restriction.
The energy thresholds are fixed inputs independent of oscillator dimension; changing E is reported explicitly rather than hidden in the cutoff.
Tail spread and endpoint ratios are computed only on the ten registered dimensions; no cutoff limit is asserted.
Signed union groups and absolute pair aggregates remain separate, including in every spectral window.
The reversed term order is rebuilt and compared with the negative forward group on every row.
All four K_U^(1/2)-Gibbs legs use the projected Gibbs square root separately; no commutation through the operator is assumed.
The independent lane reconstructs the oscillator, support terms, spectral projectors and weighted legs without importing the primary module.
Only the fixed source edge and finite matrices are used; no external bond, exact CCR or arbitrary-shape claim is inserted.
A stable low-energy finite window is only a candidate topology; common core, global KMS transfer, thermodynamic history, OS/KMS/GNS, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.
R359 checks exact grid/window/count arithmetic and scope only; spectral projectors and QFT limits remain Python/open analysis.

boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing finite low-energy spectral-window stress only. It is not a global state theorem, a cutoff-removal theorem or a QFT/Clay result.

lean_crosscheck.role: R359 checks exact finite grid/window/count arithmetic and finite-only scope; matrix spectra, Gibbs factors, common domains and QFT limits remain Python/open analysis.

named_proxy.coefficient: signed and absolute union-group window seminorms, window mass/rank, tail mass and high-cutoff spread are reported for every beta and E
named_proxy.core: finite oscillator matrix proxy on the exact two-site union support U={0,1}
named_proxy.state: rho_U=exp(-beta H_U)/Tr(exp(-beta H_U)) for the induced two-site Hamiltonian
named_proxy.weighted_state: the unnormalized window contribution uses P_E rho_U^(1/2) in all four K_U^(1/2)-Gibbs legs; the normalized conditional value is reported separately
named_proxy.window: P_E is the spectral projector of H_U-min(spec H_U) onto energies <= E, with E fixed independently of oscillator dimension
